description:
This file defines the Converter class within the Goteo
amed namespace. It handles fetching, parsing, and caching currency exchange rate data from external sources (ECB and FloatRates). The class includes methods for setting cache and reader objects, retrieving currency rates with caching, and handling errors via email notifications.

classes.name: Converter
classes.description: Handles currency exchange rate fetching, parsing, caching, and error notification.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Converter with default cache and reader objects.

methods.name: setCache
methods.description: Sets the cache object used for storing currency rates.

methods.name: setReader
methods.description: Sets the reader object used for fetching data from external sources.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Fetches and parses currency rate data from ECB or FloatRates sources based on the specified base currency.

methods.name: getRates
methods.description: Retrieves currency rates for a given base currency, utilizing cache when available.
